lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular pixel clusters are arranged in approximately four distinct horizontal rows along the mid-lateral flank posterior to the gill slits.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect the horizontal rows of spots, forming a grid-like pattern where the blobs act as intersection nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal linear feature is visible across the upper third of the flank, defined by a sharp vertical gradient from high luminance above to shadow below.

other_distinctive_markers: The rostrum and cranial region exhibit a significantly higher density of smaller, concentrated high-luminance spots compared to the larger, more dispersed spots on the lateral flank.
